# Runtime data artifacts persisted to the dedicated `data` branch.
# These generated files are NEVER committed to the code branch (main) so that
# scheduled scanner runs cannot collide with human/agent code pushes.
# One pattern per line. Blank lines and lines starting with '#' are ignored.
# Globs and directories are supported.
